contracts.blurb: Sends its monthly bond and bill orders to your desk. You earn the fee on every ticket.
Books its cocoa contracts through you with warehouse receipts. Fee per contract.
Grain contracts for maize and sorghum, placed in bulk after harvest.
Treasury bill bids for thousands of members, sent in one clean file.
Buys Nigerian bills and bonds through your desk, in cedi and naira.
Places African share and gold orders with your Johannesburg desk.

belt.name: Ticket Tube
belt.blurb: Blue capsules whoosh order tickets from the client desk to the dealing desks.

auto.name: Auto-Settlement Engine
auto.blurb: Matches every trade and prints contract notes. Failed tickets drop to 1 in 200.

pack.name: Order Routing Screen
pack.blurb: Clients type orders on kiosks and tickets appear at the right desk at once.

milestones.title: Second Client Office
milestones.blurb: Ibadan opens. Same blue jacket, same clean files.

milestones.title: Five Client Offices
milestones.blurb: Teachers, traders and pensioners across the South West know the blue ticker.

milestones.title: Ten Offices, Zero Missing Files
milestones.blurb: The regulator's audit finds every client paper in place.

milestones.title: Every Region
milestones.blurb: Client offices in the North, East and South-South, each with a compliance desk.

milestones.title: Dealer Academy
milestones.blurb: Blue Ticker trains young dealers. First lesson: count am twice, pay am once.

milestones.title: Across Africa
milestones.blurb: Accra, Nairobi and Johannesburg offices share one risk limit.

milestones.title: Round the Clock
milestones.blurb: As Lagos closes, the next desk opens. Orders pass from city to city.

milestones.title: The Opening Bell
milestones.blurb: Sade rings the Lagos opening bell with her old notebook in her pocket and Aunty Bisi in the front row.

events.name: Good Results Season
events.text: Big companies publish strong results. More clients come in with share orders today.

events.name: Red Week Nerves
events.text: Prices fell last week and clients are nervous. Fewer orders today, but every ticket still pays its fee.

events.name: Pension Fund Ticket
events.text: A pension fund sends one big bond order. Executed cleanly, it pays a bonus fee.

events.name: Wrong Ticket
events.text: A trainee typed 10,000 units instead of 1,000. Tickets move slowly while everyone double-checks.

events.name: Auction Day
events.text: Treasury bill auction today. Bigger bid tickets queue at the money market desk.

events.name: Surprise Inspection
events.text: The regulator visits tonight to check client files. Staff work sharp all day.

events.name: Naira Steady Week
events.text: The exchange rate holds calm. Currency desk clients come back smiling.

events.name: Network Down
events.text: The trading link drops for an hour. Tickets pile up while dealers work them by phone.

storyNote: Story follows plan2/trading.json with these changes: settlement is T+1 (Nigeria moved to T+1 in June 2026), not two days. Chief Dapo Fastlane's 'double by Friday' line and the Abuja rival's 'guaranteed profit' scene are left out: no promised returns, fraud, insider trading or pump-and-dump appear anywhere, not even as an offer. Red Day no longer moves prices in a day: prices of the five made-up companies move once a week. The commodities desk opens with the Johannesburg stage. Every company and ticker in the game is invented. Everything is game money and nothing is investment advice.
